text:
sara-peopleops: Heads up — assembling interview packs for last week's panel and the "recordings" slot is empty for 3 candidates. ATS shows attachments, but the pack export has no files. Anyone else seeing this?

ben-recruiter: Yep saw that too. Tried to attach manually and got a 403 from the backend upload API. Thought it was transient.

ryan-hr-ops: Hmm we rotated the S3 KMS key last Wed for the recordings bucket. Could be a key policy mismatch.

devopsbot: deploy-recordings-ingest v2026.03.21 failed: Lambda putObject -> AccessDenied. Error snippet: 
```
2026-03-21T10:12:43Z ERROR PutObject S3 AccessDenied: Access Denied (Service: S3, Status Code: 403)
Caused by: kms:Decrypt denied for arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:111122223333:key/abcd-... (User: lambda-recordings)
```

nina-hiring-manager: Is this affecting feedback sharing with candidates (we planned to include short clips in offer packets for transparency)?

ben-recruiter: Yes — pipeline that bundles clips into the ATS packet fails so the automated share is blocked. Manual download via console works for folks with AWS perms, but recruiters don't have that.

ryan-hr-ops: OK confirm root cause: new KMS key was created but we didn't add the lambda role or the ATS service account to the key policy. Quick patch is to add the following policy entry to the key: 
```
{
  "Sid": "AllowRecordsLambda",
  "Effect": "Allow",
  "Principal": { "AWS": "arn:aws:iam::111122223333:role/lambda-recordings" },
  "Action": ["kms:Decrypt","kms:GenerateDataKey"],
  "Resource": "*"
}
```
I'll apply in ~20m and roll restart the ingest.

ben-recruiter: If you can, also add the ATS service principal `arn:aws:iam::555566667777:role/ats-uploader` — that avoids the 403 on ATS-side attempts.

ryan-hr-ops: Good call. Adding both now. Will run a dry-run and then redeploy ingest. ETA 2 hours including verification.

sara-peopleops: Thanks. For the short term should we pause the automated "share with candidate" toggle so we don't surface broken links?

nina-hiring-manager: Yes please pause and note in the offer template that clips may be included later. I'll tell PMs.

ben-recruiter: I'll batch-download the three recordings and attach manually to the candidate threads so we don't block offers. Ping me if you need copy for the note. :+1:

devopsbot: post-deploy checks queued — will post success/failure.

ryan-hr-ops: Update: key policy updated and ingest redeployed. First test packet exported successfully (s3://redwood-recordings/2026/03/21/test-packet.zip). Marking this thread to close after you confirm manual packets delivered.

sara-peopleops: Confirmed manual attaches done for the 3 candidates. Closing loop — thanks everyone.
